title: SpaceX Pursues Dedicated Natural Gas Pipeline for Starship Propellant Demands
detail: SpaceX is pursuing plans to build a dedicated natural gas pipeline to supply methane for its expanding Starship fleet. As Starship production scales toward higher launch cadences, the propellant demands — liquid methane and liquid oxygen — are outpacing what existing fuel supply infrastructure can provide. A dedicated pipeline would give SpaceX direct control over propellant logistics at Starbase (Boca Chica, TX), potentially reducing costs and supply-chain bottlenecks as the company targets dozens of Starship launches per year.
